english.title: New keeper of cattle in Wales failed to update cattle passport details as required
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[new keeper]_
(B)_[market operator]_

of cattle **(..SPECIFY IDENTITY OF CATTLE..) that were moved onto a holding at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), failed to ensure the information required by paragraph 11(2) of Schedule 3 to the Cattle Identification (Wales) Regulations 2007 was marked on their cattle passport within 36 hours of their arrival
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 15 of, and paragraph 11 of Schedule 3 to, the Cattle Identification (Wales) Regulations 2007.
